rows: Call for service for a theft in progress from Giant Food.  RVN6 arrived on scene and maintained overwatch of suspect vehicle until patrol arrived.
Call for subject in Chick-fil-A harassing customers.  RVN6 arrived on scene but could not locate subject due to her being in the business.  Patrol cleared call.
L911 call for shoplifters who were physically fighting at Giant.  Patrol arrived on scene and located group.  RVN6 provided overwatch.
Call for car meetup in parking lot of Brusters.  RVN6 arrived while patrol onscene.
Call for a subject laying on the train tracks.  RVN6 arrived on scene and observed two individuals sitting on track 1.  GPD patrol made contact and subjects moved along
Call for traffic lights out at Montgomery Village Ave / Centerway.  RVN6 arrived on scene and confirmed lights out but traffic moving well.  Cancelled patrol to check during shift
Call for traffic lights out at Midcounty Hwy / Goshen Rd.  RVN6 arrived on scene and cleared, keeping patrol in service
Call for traffic lights out at Montgomery Village Ave / Centerway.  RVN6 arrived on scene and lights were operational.  Cancelled patrol
Call for domestic with male hitting female at bus stop. RVN6 arrived on scene and provided overwatch for patrol.

L911 call for suspicious subjects walking through neighborhood, possibly through yards of residences.  RVN6 arrived on scene and observed construction solicitors walking door to door. Cancelled patrol
Initial L911 call for dispute in progress.  While ONS, RVN6 observed a CDS violation and directed patrol to subject. CDS recovered from subject.
Call for subjects breaking into vehicles.  RVN6 arrived and located subjects who were with patrol. Additional calls for theft from auto received in the area
Call for suspicious subjects in the area, possibly related to previous theft from auto.  RVN6 circulated with negative results.
L911 call for subjects vandalizing apartment building.  RVN6 arrived and circulated with negative results.
GPD advised theft in progress at Downtown Crown..RVN6 arrived on scene and observed subjects leaving store.  GPS stopped and arrest was made
L911 for collision.  Arrived on scene and located vehicles.  RVN6 provided overwatch for GPD patrol
Call for an assault at McDonalds.  RVN6 arrived on scene and located subjects inside business.  Provided overwatch for patrol
Call from security for subject trespassing at apartment complex.  RVN6 arrived and located subject.  Patrol was able to move him from the area
Call for domestic dispute off Gunners Branch.  RVN6 arrived on scene and subjects had left area
Call for vandalism on Professional Drive.  RVN6 located suspect and directed patrol.
Initial call for theft at Five Below.  Diverted to theft on Lost Knife.
Call for theft just occurred.  RVN6 made contact with complainant via phone, advised subject left and property returned.  Call cleared and patrol not dispatched
Call for subject stumbling into the roadway.  RVN6 arrived and did not observe anyone in distress in the area. Patrol placed back in service.
GPD called out for foot pursuit following a theft.  RVN6 arrived and circulated for second subject with negative results.  GPD apprehended one.
L911 call for indecent exposure.  RVN6 arrived and did not observe anyone, cleared patrol.
Call for an assault in progress.  Patrol arrived and provided overwatch for patrol.
L911 calls for issues with traffic signals at 355/Perry Pkwy.  Observed traffic flowing well and TMC enroute.  Advised GPD to check on patrol
L911 for dispute after a collision.  RVN6 arrived first on scene and provided overwatch until GPD cleared call.
Call for subj drinking outside store. located and provided overwatch.
Trespasser for subj drinking from earlier.
Call or an assault in progress.  RVN6 arrived on scene and provided overwatch for patrol
Call for one down in parking lot, driver just working on his car. Cleared patrol
Call for subj walking on 270 north. GOA
Call for female passed out on bench. Refused FRS, cleared patrol
L911 call for suspicious situation at Motel6.  RVN6 arrived first ONS and id not observe any suspicious activity.  GPD confirmed no issues.
Call from security for subject harassing children.  RVN6 arrived on scene and provided overwatch, patrol unable to locate subject.
The caller reported a burglary in progress.
A caller reported a subject in need of assistance on the ground at the intersection.  The subject was located.
Call for subjects engaging in lewd conduct.  RVN6 started but patrol unit cleared before arrival.
L911 call for subject refusing to pay and becoming irate.  RVN6 arrived on scene and monitored.  Patrol held call and RVN had to return due to battery.
L911 call for an assault in progress.  RVN6 arrived on scene and observed subject and no dispute. Patrol cleared call.
L911 call for subject being disorderly in Verizon store.  RVN6 arrived and located subject who was escorted from business.
Call for indecent exposure in progress.  RVN6 arrived on scene and subjects were gone on arrival.
L911 for child attempting to jump from window.  RVN6 arrived and located child, guided patrol and ensured safety until arrival of ground units.
Call for subject passed out in grass, subject was gone on arrival. Canceled patrol.
L911 for domestic dispute with subject breaking windows.  RVN6 arrived and located subject leaving the residence.
L911 call for a dispute in progress.  While en route, caller cancelled call.  Did not locate upon arrival
L911 for an assault in progress.  RVN6 arrived and observed subject who was arrested by GPD patrol.
L911 for young child walking barefoot in parking lot.  Arrived ONS but had to return due to another call for service.
L911 call for sound of shots and arguing in wooded area.  RVN6 arrived and located two subjects on the trail, directed patrol in from roadway.
L911 call for disorderly customers at the location.  Raven 6 arrived on scene and provided over watch for patrol.
L911 call for subject shoplifting.  RVN6 arrived and located subject.  Stopped by patrol, had outstanding theft warrants.
Call for subjects drinking in area near a park.  RVN6 arrived and located five (5) subjects.  Guided patrol to their location and patrol handled
L911 call for subject banging on door, attempting to break in.  RVN6 arrived and provided overwatch for patrol.  Nothing located by patrol
L911 call for a theft in progress from the 7-11.  RVN6 arrived but subject was GOA
L911 call for dispute turned assault.  RVN6 arrived on scene and observed subject banging on vehicle window.  Subject left in vehicle, guided patrol to location
L911 call for a theft just occurred, subject fled.  RVN6 arrived and circulated with negative results
L911 call for a domestic dispute where subject was destroying items.  RVN6 arrived but subject had left the scene.
L911 call for repeat trespasser.  RVN6 arrived and located subject who left the area.  Complainant cancelled police, RVN cleared patrol
Call for shoplifters running out of Hmart
Intox subj passed out in front of bank. circulated with negative results
Shoplifting in progress. Theft not confirmed.
Call for theft in progress at Aldi.  RVN6 arrived and located subject, followed on two different Ride On busses.  Patrol was able to stop and trespass subject
Caller advised of an armed subject making threats also
Fight in progress outside the main gate of the fair.  Provided overwatch as group dispersed
Assist MCFRS with overwatch for fair workers stuck off the ground in a boom lift.
Assist a specialized unit in locating suspects related to ongoing investigation.  Located and followed until detectives took over and stopped individuals
L911 call for a traffic accident with an unknown dispute
L911 call for a subject who hit the window of a vehicle
L911 call fora burglary in progress
L911 call for a disorderly subject in the store.
L911 for a theft in progress
L911 for assault. RVN6 located subject and guided patrol to location
